observations.content: Extended message_subagent tool in extensions/subagent-types/index.ts to add optional name and kind params; agentId resolution via resolveSubagentName from registry (params.agentId ?? resolveSubagentName(params.name)?.agentId), send to targetId instead of params.agentId, and msg adds kind 'reply'/'message'.

Added new ask_question tool (child-to-main) to index.ts before the Smoke hook: sends kind:'ask' to main, waits wait_seconds (default 90, max 300) via waitForReply, absorbs reply if it arrives or parks if timed out; errors if called by main agent.
Updated allowlist in index.ts line 148 to include ask_question: allowlistFor returns [...def.tools.map(mapToolName), 'message_main', 'message_subagent', 'ask_question'].

bun test showed 1 fail and tsc reported TS2322 at index.ts:692 — ask_question execute did not satisfy AgentToolResult because its details returns were a heterogeneous union ({}, {asked,repliedBy}, {asked,parked}).

Fixed the TS error by declaring a single typed const details: { asked?: string; repliedBy?: string; parked?: boolean } = {} and mutating it in each ask_question return branch; result was 0 fail / 45 tests / TSC_CLEAN.
Fixed failing allowlist test in index.test.ts (mermaid-maker expected list) by appending ask_question to the expected channel tools.

First python edit script died on an assert for the reply-branch details text because the file contained real newlines (multiline template literal) instead of literal backslash-n; the test-file write had already applied, so tests passed but index.ts was unchanged.
Redid index.ts ask_question details fix using exact file text (details: { asked..., repliedBy... } -> details with pre-return assignments); result 0 fail / 45 tests / TSC_CLEAN.

Added Phase 2 tests to channel.test.ts covering name registry (register/resolve roundtrip, same-name latest-wins, unknown -> undefined, corrupt registry.json -> empty non-fatal) and waitForReply (queued reply resolves immediately, timeout -> undefined, mid-wait reply absorbed); 52 tests / 0 fail across 2 files.

Synced paseo-channel.ts, index.ts, channel.test.ts to .pi/extensions/subagent-types/ and ran timeout 60 smoke /tmp/smoke-chan.ts: ok true, loaded true, commands include readonly-dev, subagent-types-dev, ask-user-question-dev, md-log.

E2E spawn_subagent of a scout named asker (to test registry path + ask_question absorb) failed twice with 'Spawn failed: no MCP response (http 202)'; assistant suspected post-restart daemon behavior and initially considered it transient.

Investigated loopback endpoint: only /tmp/paseo-pi-mcp-pJMw1M dir exists, callerAgentId cf76ad71-3f82-4296-960f-fa9e2fcd06ee; direct get_agent_status call returned HTTP 200 showing assistant's own agent status running (provider pi, model cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3, thinkingOptionId max, workspace wks_ad5f10e3d6ad2c06).

Direct create_agent probe over the loopback returned HTTP 200 but MCP error -32602 validation: provider must be provider/model format (e.g. codex/gpt-5.4); this showed the endpoint works while spawning via extension gave http 202.

paseo_list_agents via mcp server returned 16 agents; no 'asker' agent was created, so the two http 202 spawn failures did not leave a child. Agent list shows current subagent models are cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash and cli-openai/mmcp/MiniMax-M3, and assistant's own agent /om (cf76ad71) is running.
